key.name: modules-media
key.description: What is playing, from any MPRIS player, with its tab.

key.name: media-compact-on-hover
key.description: The pill grows into the track, its buttons and position.

key.name: modules-notification
key.description: Notifications in the pill, with their own buttons.

key.name: notification-replace-banners
key.description: Off, GNOME shows its own.

key.name: modules-hud
key.description: Volume, brightness and lock keys in the pill, instead of GNOME's popup.

key.name: hud-replace-osd
key.description: Off, GNOME shows its own.

key.name: modules-home
key.description: The blocks of the Home tab.

key.name: modules-progress
key.description: File copies and downloads, with the Transfers tab.

key.name: progress-folders
key.description: Browser downloads show from your Downloads folder and from these, up to 10. Folders inside them are not watched.

key.name: modules-print
key.description: A print job in the pill till it is done, and the printer's problems, in place of GNOME's printer notifications.

key.name: modules-timer
key.description: Timers in the pill, with the Timer tab; saved timers shared with GNOME Clocks.

key.name: timer-keep-awake
key.description: While a timer runs it does not suspend; the screen still turns off and locks.

key.name: timer-pomodoro-work
key.description: Minutes of a focus turn.

key.name: timer-pomodoro-break
key.description: Minutes of a short break.

key.name: timer-pomodoro-long
key.description: Minutes of the break after the last round.

key.name: timer-pomodoro-rounds
key.description: Focus turns before the long break.

key.name: timer-state
key.description: Bookkeeping: the timers running or paused, by when they end, so a restart keeps them.

key.name: timer-last
key.description: Bookkeeping: the length last started, in seconds, for the tab and Home's tile.

key.name: modules-greeting
key.description: Bu says hello when the computer starts, welcome back and goodbye, special days, and what is new after an update.

key.name: greeting-style
key.description: When the computer starts or wakes from a long sleep.

key.name: greeting-farewell
key.description: A line when you shut down, restart or log out.

key.name: greeting-name
key.description: What Bu calls you; empty: your first name.

key.name: greeting-birthday
key.description: Bu wishes you a happy birthday.

key.name: greeting-holidays
key.description: Your region's by the time zone.

key.name: greeting-boot
key.description: Bookkeeping: the boot Bu last saw, to tell a start.

key.name: greeting-session
key.description: Bookkeeping: the login session Bu last saw, to tell a welcome back.

key.name: greeting-asleep
key.description: Bookkeeping: seconds asleep since boot when Bu last looked, to tell a wake.

key.name: greeting-intro-shown
key.description: Bookkeeping: Bu introduced himself once; About sets it false to show it again.

key.name: greeting-version-seen
key.description: Bookkeeping: the last version What's new spoke for.

key.name: greeting-updates
key.summary: Say when a newer Buoy is out
key.description: Bu says once when a newer version is ready. Installed from extensions.gnome.org, GNOME Shell finds it; installed with install.sh, Buoy asks GitHub for the latest release at most once a day.

key.name: greeting-update-checked
key.description: Bookkeeping: when GitHub was last asked for the latest release (seconds since the epoch).

key.name: greeting-update-told
key.description: Bookkeeping: the newer version Bu last spoke of.

key.name: prefs-page
key.description: Bookkeeping: the page prefs opens on, then clears (whats-new).

key.name: modules-calendar
key.description: Today and the week ahead in the Calendar tab, and the next event as an idle plan.

key.name: calendar-meeting-alert
key.description: An event comes 5 minutes before it starts, with Join when it has a meeting link (Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Webex, Jitsi), and stays till 10 minutes after; in place of GNOME's reminder for it.

key.name: calendar-refresh
key.description: Google and others; GNOME fetches them hourly.

key.name: modules-device
key.description: The Devices tab: this computer, wireless and plugged devices. Pinned after Calendar.

key.name: modules-input
key.description: A short flash when you switch input source or input method.

key.name: input-replace-switcher
key.description: Off, holding Super+Space shows GNOME's list.

key.name: modules-agent
key.description: Your Claude Code sessions in the pill, and their permission prompts.

key.name: agent-quiet-focused
key.description: While its terminal is focused, a session's pill does not open on its own.

key.name: modules-privacy
key.description: A dot on the pill while the microphone, the camera or the screen is in use; a recording or a screen share in the pill, with Stop.

key.name: privacy-call-dnd
key.description: While the camera and the microphone are both on.

key.name: privacy-dot
key.description: Where the microphone, camera and screen show they are in use: the pill's dot in place of GNOME's icons and buttons, GNOME's alone, or both.

key.name: modules-power
key.description: Plugging in, unplugging and a full battery in a short flash; a low battery stays in the pill until you plug in, in place of GNOME's notification.

key.name: modules-plugged
key.description: A display or headphones plugged in, in a short flash; a new display offers Join, Mirror or External Only.

key.name: modules-bluetooth
key.description: A Bluetooth device connected or disconnected, in a short flash with its battery.

key.name: modules-usb
key.description: A drive, a phone or a webcam plugged in; a drive offers Open and Eject, in place of GNOME's notification.

key.name: modules-attention
key.description: A window that asks for attention (an app ready on another workspace, a terminal's bell) stays on the pill till you go to it, in place of GNOME's notification.

key.name: modules-network
key.description: A flash when Wi-Fi, a cable or a VPN connects or drops; a network asking you to sign in stays on the pill, in place of GNOME's notifications.

key.name: modules-terminal
key.description: A command that finished in a Ptyxis tab you are not in stays on the pill till you go to it, in place of Ptyxis's notification.

key.name: modules-phone
key.description: A call on the phone through GSConnect, ringing or going on, and the Phone tab with its calls and messages.

key.name: phone-ring
key.description: The system's incoming call sound while the phone rings, until it stops, it is answered, or Mute or × is pressed. Silent with Do Not Disturb, GSConnect's sound alerts off, or system sounds off.

key.name: modules-copied
key.description: A short flash of what you copied.

key.name: copied-show-preview
key.description: The text, the file names or a thumbnail of the image. Off, the pill only says Copied and the clipboard is not read.

key.name: modules-clipboard
key.description: The Clipboard tab, in the strip's slot unless another is chosen.

key.name: modules-clock
key.description: A second clock in the idle pill, with the part of the day.

key.name: modules-weather
key.description: The condition and temperature where you are.

key.name: modules-mascot
key.description: Bu's eyes in the idle pill: they look at what you missed, and sleep at night or when you are away.

key.name: idle-content
key.description: Automatic shows what matters now; Nothing keeps only the light.

key.name: idle-calendar-all-day
key.description: Shown when nothing with a time is left today.

key.name: idle-auto-plans
key.description: The idle plans Automatic may show, in the order they take turns.

key.name: idle-auto-switch
key.description: Minutes before the next plan takes its turn.

key.name: idle-mascot-stroll
key.description: While you are at the desk, Bu's eyes look around, blink and smile now and then. Off, they stay still.

key.name: idle-clock-style
key.description: The time follows Date & Time: 12 or 24 hours, with seconds or not.

key.name: idle-weather-automatic
key.description: Where you are, with Location Services on. Off, the city below.

key.name: idle-weather-locate-now
key.summary: Refresh the place and the weather now
key.description: Prefs' refresh button writes the time (µs); Buoy then locates again, Wi-Fi first, and fetches the weather.

key.name: idle-weather-located
key.description: Written by Buoy: wifi (a good fix), ip (an IP guess used), kept (only IP, the place kept), none (no fix).

key.name: idle-weather-located-at
key.description: Written by Buoy, ms since the epoch.

key.name: idle-weather-updated-at
key.description: Written by Buoy, ms since the epoch.

key.name: idle-weather-refresh
key.description: Asked only while the pill shows the weather.

key.name: apps-hidden
key.description: Apps whose activities never show. Any id an app goes by; it is slugged.

key.name: apps-plain
key.description: Apps drawn by the default adapter instead of their own.

key.name: tabs-pinned
key.description: Standalone tabs shown in the strip all the time, besides the slot.

key.name: tabs-slot
key.summary: Standalone tab in the strip's slot
key.description: Set by choosing a tab from ⋯. Empty or not enabled: the first enabled standalone tab.

key.name: expanded-width
key.description: 0 fits it to the monitor.

key.name: dev-mode
key.description: Lets Looking Glass reload one module without restarting the Shell.

key.name: keybind-focus
key.description: ←/→ move · Enter opens · Esc lets go

key.name: daypart-starts
key.description: When each starts. The clock's icon and Bu's greeting follow.

key.name: activity-linger
key.description: Paused or done pills, and unanswered asks.

key.name: mascot-rest-after
key.description: Seconds without input before Bu holds still.

key.name: cluster-background
key.description: Behind the left and right clusters.

key.name: cluster-contrast
key.description: Automatic follows the wallpaper, not the style.

key.name: left-cluster-empty
key.description: Left cluster, on the desktop and in the Overview.

key.name: clock-defaults-applied
key.description: Set after the first enable gave GNOME's clock Buoy's defaults (the time alone, 24-hour) on the keys the user had not set.

key.name: weather-defaults-applied
key.description: Set after the first enable gave GNOME Weather's units °C and km/h where the user had not chosen them.

key.name: dock-defaults-applied
key.description: Set after the first enable gave Ubuntu's dock Buoy's defaults (at the bottom, hiding, 32 px, primary display only) on the keys the user had not set.

key.name: cluster-radius
key.description: 16 is a pill, like the island.

key.name: cluster-opacity
key.description: How strong the background is. 17 matches a top bar button's hover; with a menu open it is a little stronger, as GNOME's.

key.name: window-corners
key.description: Like a floating window's, with the wallpaper behind them. The bottom stays square.

key.name: window-corners-radius
key.description: 15 is a floating window's.
